about_the_game:
Ink Enigma: Hidden Object Challenges turns every hand-drawn puzzle page into your personal sketchbook. Scan the scene, circle each secret, and watch the artwork come alive with your own signature ink.

Why It Feels So Good

Draw to Discover – Spot an item, press the trigger, and shhkk!—a lively marker-stroke wraps around it as if you sketched it yourself. A crisp checklist tick follows with an old-school paper-flip sound.

Page-Turner Puzzles – Enjoy a growing gallery of lovingly illustrated scenes, with even more discoveries planned for future updates.

Personal Best Timing – Every page records your fastest completion time, inviting you to out-ink your own record whenever inspiration strikes.

Your Marker, Your Style – Tweak opacity, thickness, and hue: go subtle pencil-grey or blaze neon—no two finished pages have to look the same.

Relax & Recline – Warm parchment tones, gentle jazz-hop loops, zero jump-scares. Perfect for five-minute brain breaks or long, cozy play sessions.

Pick-Up-and-Play Controls – Controller, mouse, or touch—the UI instantly adapts to whatever you grab.
